summary: Re-validation of the 3 CRITICAL backend bugs found in iteration_9 ('configurable tips' feature). All fixes verified GREEN. Backend pytest suite expanded from 14 to 16 cases and 16/16 pass, including new strict assertions for: (a) PUT /api/cashiers/{id} with default_tip_percent: null clears the field, (b) updating cashier 'name' alone does NOT clobber default_tip_percent, (c) POST /api/orders without subtotal auto-derives subtotal=total-tip and returns 200 (legacy/offline-queued payloads work), (d) when subtotal IS supplied it is preserved verbatim. Frontend E2E smoke (login → /settings → save 15% → reload → still 15) PASSES. /cashiers shows saiko with 'Propina 20%' badge. /stats shows stat-tips-card=$88.00 with ranking sorted desc. /pos CashierGate with saiko PIN 1234 login works (Hola, saiko toast). The full checkout-tip auto-active flow was validated in iteration_8 prior to backend regression and is now unblocked.

minor.issue: Ranking still includes a 'Sin cajero' (__none__) bucket for orders without cashier_id. Considered cosmetic — UI labels it correctly ('Sin cajero'). Backend contract is clear.

notes: Login flake from iteration_9 was resolved by using page.locator('input[type=password]').press('Enter') instead of click on submit button.
Product cards have a '+ opciones' badge requiring an options modal flow to be added to cart; this is unchanged pre-existing behavior and not part of the tip feature.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_cashier now correctly uses model_dump(exclude_unset=True), allowing explicit null clears for default_tip_percent without overwriting other fields — verified by 'update name only does not clobber tip' test.
server.py create_order now auto-derives subtotal = total - tip when omitted — verified end-to-end via POST without subtotal returning 200 and subtotal=100 for {total=110, tip=10} payload.
Business + BusinessUpdate models now declare default_tip_percent — GET returns 15 after PUT 15, persists across reload in /settings UI.
test_tips_feature.py is a solid regression gate; recommend keeping it in CI.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_tips_feature.py (added 3 new strict assertions: PUT null clears, name-only edit preserves tip, POST without subtotal auto-derives, POST with subtotal preserved)

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the 4 tip-feature surfaces verified (settings save+reload, cashiers badge, stats card+ranking, cashier-gate PIN login)

Future testing agents can run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_tips_feature.py -v` as the gate. POS cashier-gate PIN input is a single masked field (input[type=password] inside the gate panel after clicking the cashier row); after correct PIN a 'Hola, saiko' toast appears and the /pos main view becomes interactive with the cashier name shown in the left sidebar.
rca of the issue: Iteration_9 bugs were all root-caused and surgically fixed: (1) Business/BusinessUpdate Pydantic models gained `default_tip_percent: float = 0.0` / `Optional[float] = None` so PUT/GET round-trip the field. (2) update_cashier handler swapped its hand-rolled `if x is not None` filter for `update.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)`, distinguishing 'omitted' vs 'explicit null' and supporting clear-to-global. (3) create_order now computes `subtotal = total - tip` when subtotal is None/omitted before constructing Order(...), fixing the OrderCreate.subtotal=Optional vs Order.subtotal=required mismatch that crashed the legacy/offline payload path. All three are covered by new pytest assertions to prevent regression.
